job-service's MCP server

Streamable HTTP at /mcp, stateless, answering JSON. Every request takes the submitters' bearer token (AUTH_TOKEN), as the API does: each tool is one API request made with it, so it is refused, recorded and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, in the API's words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "job-service": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4500/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <AUTH_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

job-service runs jobs on a fleet of hosts: a job is a named script in a repo's jobs.toml, a run one execution of it at one commit, placed by its scheduler on a host that meets its requirements (os, arch, memory). - A run is submitted pending, assigned to a host by the scheduler, running there, and ends succeeded, failed or canceled with its exit code. - A run's log is read from a byte offset: get_run_log answers the bytes from offset, the log's size, and the run's state, so call it again from offset + the bytes read until the state has ended. - Label runs to find them again (e.g. {"item": "28af81bc", "by": "agent-7"}); list_runs filters by label as key=value. - Pending runs are taken highest priority first, then oldest; give priority when submitting, or move a run with update_run_priority. - Give retry {limit, backoff} to try a failed run again: each attempt keeps its own log and exit, the run's attempts lists the earlier ones, and get_run_log reads any by attempt. - cancel_run ends a pending or assigned run at once; a running one is stopped by its host shortly after. - Every tool takes the submitters' token this server was connected with. The host protocol (register, connect, heartbeat, append, complete) is job-runner's, not tools.

Tools

  • submit_run Submit a run
  • list_runs List runs
  • get_run Get a run
  • get_run_log Read a run's log
  • cancel_run Cancel a run
  • update_run_priority Update run priority
  • list_hosts List hosts

submit_run

Queues a run as pending, by priority then age, until a host that meets its requirements takes it. The repo isn't checked here: a missing job fails on its host.

InputTypeRequired
repostringyesGitHub repo, owner/name.
commitstringyesFull commit sha to check out.
jobstringyesA [jobs.<name>] in the repo's jobs.toml.
argsstring[]Arguments appended to the job's command.
requirementsobjectWhat the run needs from its host.
requirements.oslinux, macos, windows or nullOperating system it needs. Default: any.
requirements.archx86_64, aarch64 or nullCPU architecture it needs. Default: any.
requirements.memoryinteger or nullMemory in MiB. Default: jobs.toml's, else 1024.
requirements.timeoutinteger or nullTimeout in seconds. Default: jobs.toml's.
labelsobjectLabels to find it by, e.g. what it is for and who asked.
priorityintegerHigher is placed first; equal ones oldest first. -1000 to 1000. Default: 0.
retryobjectRetries a failed attempt (not a canceled one).
retry.limitintegerRetries after a failed attempt, 0 to 10. Default: 0.
retry.backoffintegerSeconds before the first retry, doubling for each after, at most 3600. Default: 10.

list_runs reads only

Returns runs matching every filter given, newest first.

InputTypeRequired
statepending, assigned, running, succeeded, failed, canceledpending → assigned → running → succeeded, failed or canceled. An assignment not taken goes back to pending.
repostringGitHub repo, owner/name.
labelstring or string[]Only runs with this label, as key=value. Repeat to require several.
limitintegerMax results. Default: 100.

get_run reads only

Returns one run.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.

get_run_log reads only

Returns the latest attempt's log, or attempt's, from byte offset, at most 1 MiB, with the log's size so far and the attempt's state. Empty when offset is the log's size: call again later from there while the run is pending or running.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.
offsetintegerThe byte to read from; default 0.
attemptintegerWhich attempt's log; default the latest. A run's attempts lists its earlier ones.

cancel_run

Ends a run not yet started (pending or assigned) now. A running one is stopped by its host within seconds.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.

update_run_priority

Moves a run not yet ended up or down the queue. A running one keeps its host.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe run's id.
priorityintegeryesHigher is placed first; equal ones oldest first. -1000 to 1000.

list_hosts reads only

Returns every host in the fleet, most recently seen first, with its capacity, free capacity and health.

No input.
